harm_description: Auto-generated script inaccurately described a private venue as publicly accessible and suggested illegal pathing
existing_controls: Human editorial review available before publish; creator guidelines exist
proposed_controls: Require explicit verification step for venue claims; add location-verification check and warning in UI
human_oversight: Editor or creator must confirm location facts before publish; checklist enforced
monitoring_metric: Number of published videos with unverified location claims
response_action: Pause publishing flow investigate and correct content; notify affected parties and review generator prompts

existing_controls: Default anonymization and aggregate thresholds; opt-out available
proposed_controls: Add conservative segmenting for sensitive cohorts; require manual approval for high-frequency pushes; add privacy impact check
human_oversight: Channel manager reviews recommended segments and approves schedule
monitoring_metric: Number of privacy complaints and opt-outs for targeted segments
response_action: Throttle recommendations require manual review; notify compliance and reduce push frequency
